description: Name labels over the video: expected top-left corners for the shared placement rule. Checked by frontend/tests/label-layout.test.ts (player/labelLayout.ts) and backend/tests/test_label_layout.py (export/label_layout.py). Labels are [anchor x, anchor y (bottom), width, height]; bounds are [left, top, right, bottom].

cases.name: far apart: each label centred above its anchor
close: pushed apart sideways, each still over its anchor
close with fractions: the push is split evenly
near the left edge: the other label takes the rest of the push
same spot: stacked, the label with the higher anchor on top
at the left edge without room: stacked, the left label on top on a tie
same spot at the top edge: the lower label goes below instead
outside the picture: pulled back inside
export: kept below the top band
wider than the picture: sticks to the left edge
